candidate_source_binding: the additive A/B/C kernels, fixed-shape count-18 bridge, Rust API and receipts, gate example, tests, custody inputs, and this predeclaration must be committed and pushed together before the first candidate performance sample

scope.stage: count-matched primitive mechanism screen only; a pass authorizes separate opt-in production plumbing and does not accept an end-to-end runtime
scope.model_shape: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B recurrent GDN updates at the 18 production linear-attention layers

production_call_mapping.qualification: source- and ledger-derived mapping; not a performance counter

B.mechanism: lane 0 computes beta and decay once and publishes two f32 values to the threadgroup

C.mechanism: B plus cooperative staging of the 128-element Q and K rows through the same single barrier

pre_sampling_exactness_diagnosis.finding: a redundant candidate-side fixed-shape guard changed Metal fast-math code generation and caused one one-ULP next-state mismatch; duplicate 256-thread, duplicate 128-thread, leader-broadcast, and Q/K-staged minimizations isolated the guard
pre_sampling_exactness_diagnosis.resolution: the redundant shader guard was removed; the no-argument host constructor and fixed constants enforce the shape before encoding; the existing uniform value-head range guard remains
pre_sampling_exactness_diagnosis.candidate_admission_requirement: the committed B and C functions must match A to_bits for all core and next-state elements in the fixed eight-fixture gate

pre_sampling_nonperformance_pipeline_obs.classification: debug exactness smoke metadata only; no latency or throughput was sampled
pre_sampling_nonperformance_pipeline_obs.formal_gate_requirement: the release gate must observe these same allocations while separately retaining the source-declared 0/8/1032 byte ledger

count18_aggregate_topology_per_successfu.barrier_qualification: B/C each contain one source barrier site executed by all 288 threadgroups per aggregate call; this is source-derived and is not a hardware performance counter
count18_aggregate_topology_per_successfu.trailing_barrier_qualification: 17 broad barriers order adjacent dispatches and one final symmetric trailing barrier mirrors the production consumer convention
count18_aggregate_topology_per_successfu.zero_copy_qualification: zero explicit bridge memcpy inside run(), not zero GPU, cache, shared-memory, or unified-memory traffic

source_logical_traffic_per_aggregate_cal.qualification: counts source expressions only; no cache, system-memory, DRAM, bank-conflict, spill, or physical-traffic claim is made

fixed_fixture.generator: wrapping xorshift64 with x^=x<<13; x^=x>>7; x^=x<<17, all payloads hashed as little-endian f32 bits with domain and shape tags
fixed_fixture.signed_zero_sentinels: fixed +0.0 and -0.0 locations in every Q, K, V, and state row
fixed_fixture.coefficient_cycle: a_log and dt_bias use j=seam*16+head and are identical across fixtures; projected b and target_gate use fixture_index+j; projected_a is f32(target_gate-dt_bias)

correctness_gate.snapshot_qualification: the first invalid-selector check has no snapshot and its two snapshot attempts materialize nothing; the final check materializes one before and one after snapshot to prove bitwise non-mutation

fixed_staging_ledger.qualification: the fixed coefficient arrays are intentionally copied by the current stage_fixture API on every one of the eight correctness stages and the one performance restage

fixed_performance_schedule.position_balance: each arm occupies each position 1 through 6 exactly once across the three blocks
fixed_performance_schedule.transition_balance: each directed non-self pair occurs twice within blocks; cross-block edges AB and BC are explicitly outside this balance claim
fixed_performance_schedule.timing: host monotonic elapsed time around one complete synchronous aggregate GPU call; staging, poisoning, snapshots, custody checks, input verification, statistics, and JSON work are outside timing
fixed_performance_schedule.primary_statistic: even median of raw aggregate-call latency per arm in each block and pooled
fixed_performance_schedule.percentiles: diagnostic p10/p90 use sorted index floor((n-1)*q)

precommitted_selection_and_admission.step_1_provisional_selection: select C iff pooled I(C over B) >= 0.5%; otherwise select B
precommitted_selection_and_admission.step_2_no_fallback: never fall back to the other candidate if the provisional candidate fails any later rule
precommitted_selection_and_admission.step_4_block_consistency: selected-over-A improvement must be strictly >0 in all three blocks
precommitted_selection_and_admission.step_5_simplicity_guard: selected-versus-unselected improvement must be strictly >-0.5% in every block
precommitted_selection_and_admission.step_6_C_specific_consistency: if C is selected, C-over-B must be strictly positive in at least two blocks
precommitted_selection_and_admission.equality_behavior: >=0.5 selects C; >=5.0 passes pooled; 0.0 is not positive; <=-0.5 rejects the simplicity guard
precommitted_selection_and_admission.overall_pass: exactness AND completed fixed schedule AND selection rules AND valid runtime receipts AND unchanged source/binary/git custody AND zero sampled failures
precommitted_selection_and_admission.pass_authorizes: separate opt-in production-path integration plus a new predeclared end-to-end gate
precommitted_selection_and_admission.failure_action: publish the create-new raw receipt and a rejection summary, then revert candidate implementation while retaining predeclaration and evidence
